mapper.select: SELECT c.customer_id, c.ci_hash FROM customer c JOIN account a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE a.opened_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.birth_date, c.phone, c.investor_type FROM customer c WHERE c.name LIKE CONCAT(#{name}, '%') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account a WHERE a.customer_id = c.customer_id ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.name = #{name} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, c.created_at DESC, c.customer_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
